description: Find public clinical trials the registry updated on or after a date, for a condition (query) or to check one trial (nctId). This uses the registry's last-update date only: it tells you a record changed, not what changed, so send a person to the trial page for the details. Give either query or nctId, plus since as YYYY-MM-DD. Paged like search_clinical_trials. Send conditions and places only, never a person's name, diagnosis history, medications or other health details. Not medical advice.

nctId.description: One trial to check. Use this or query.

query.description: Condition, treatment or sponsor. Use this or nctId.

since.description: Date as YYYY-MM-DD; trials updated on or after it are kept.

name: get_recent_trial_changes

distanceMiles.description: Miles to the nearest site, only when a zip or radius was searched.

lastUpdatePostDate.description: Date the registry last updated the record (YYYY-MM-DD).

locations.description: At most the first 10 sites. Use the trial page for all of them.

maxAge.description: Maximum age in whole years, null when the registry gives none.

minAge.description: Minimum age in whole years, null when the registry gives none.

phase.description: Registry phases joined with a slash, for example PHASE2/PHASE3.

title: Find recently updated trials
